body:
It appears that the most doc pages redirect to a version under `versions/master/docs/...` but not the pages listed below. Perhaps this pages were removed in the new version of the website? Maybe they still appear in the old location by some transient effect?

There appear to be two issues:
1) When a page is removed from the repo it should disappear from the http://bazel.build website entirely.
2) The auto generated docs from Skylar and some other files are still pointing to the old website structure, e.g. https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/5d8a44ccc3536f2327898e8671670ef9bafd6095/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/rules/java/JavaRuleOutputJarsProvider.java#L40

http://bazel.build/docs/cpp.html => NO REDIRECT
http://bazel.build/docs/tutorial/index.html => NO REDIRECT
http://bazel.build/docs/be/docker.html => NO REDIRECT
http://bazel.build/docs/be/pkg.html => NO REDIRECT
http://bazel.build/docs/skyframe.html => NO REDIRECT
http://bazel.build/docs/skylark/lib/JavaAnnotationProcessing.html => NO REDIRECT
http://bazel.build/docs/skylark/lib/JavaCompilationInfo.html => NO REDIRECT
http://bazel.build/docs/skylark/lib/JavaOutput.html => NO REDIRECT
http://bazel.build/docs/skylark/lib/JavaOutputJars.html => NO REDIRECT

All the other doc pages I tested, did the redirect to **`versions/master/docs/...`** successfully. Examples include:

http://bazel.build/docs/external.html => https://bazel.build/versions/master/docs/external.html
http://bazel.build/docs/build-ref.html => https://bazel.build/versions/master/docs/build-ref.html

The faulty behavior was indeed also reported to me this morning.

As you said, the fact that https://bazel.build/docs/cpp.html was still available is due to a problem in the way we deploy the website. It should not exist. I deleted the file behind it in our GCS bucket and sent in https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/2553 a redirect to the correct page.

issue.title: Website deploy mechanism should remove old files before pushing new site

repository.name: bazel
repository.description: a fast, scalable, multi-language and extensible build system

issue.body:
We encountered #2551 because our deployment script seems to not remove old files in Google Cloud Storage before deploying a new version of the website. This means that if we delete a file and do not replace it by a redirect, the old file will still be served publicly (and indexed by search engines!).

This makes our deployment neither reproducible nor correct :)

body:
@brunobowden indeed, your original report pointed to more broken redirect that I tried to fix in PR #2553. 

I opened #2556 to work on a real fix, because today nothing prevents this to happen again.

Adding @davidzchen who knows best how our docs are deployed and how/why it's organized the way it is. As far as I'm concerned we intend(ed) to serve versioned docs (corresponding to each Bazel release), but never fully implemented the necessary pipeline changes.
PR #2553 should fix the problems described earlier. Let me assign #2556 to @davidzchen.
